descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Expleo is a global engineering, technology, and consulting service provider that partners with leading organizations to guide them through their business transformation, helping them achieve operational excellence and future-proof their businesses.
Expleo benefits from more than 50 years of experience developing complex products in automotive and aerospace, optimizing manufacturing processes, and ensuring the quality of information systems. Leveraging its deep sector knowledge and wide-ranging expertise in fields including AI engineering, digitalization, automation, cybersecurity and data science, the group’s mission is to fast-track innovation through each step of the value chain.
With a worldwide presence in 30 countries, our global footprint includes excellence centers around the world, including Romania since 1994.
 Responsibilities
 Develop and integrate software modules within the system infrastructure 
 Responsible for software development from driver level up to user interface (UI) 
 Collaborate closely with firmware engineers and system teams to ensure seamless interaction between software layers. 
 Implement and optimize complex algorithms within embedded and real-time environments. 
 Participate in the entire development lifecycle - from design to implementation, integration, and testing. 
 Maintain and enhance existing code, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and scalability. 
 Provide technical support for customer integration and on-site activities when needed. 
 Qualifications
 Technical Requirements 
 BSc or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Software Engineering. 
 Strong understanding of pointers, memory management, and low-level software concepts. 
 Proven experience in C++ (high-level OOP language). 
 Relevant software development experience. 
 Soft Skills
 Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal). 
 Highly motivated, dynamic, and a fast learner. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams. 
 Desired Skills
 Experience with QT Framework for UI development is an advantage. 
 Experience with CMake build systems – strong advantage. 
 Knowledge of multithreaded OS environments and real-time embedded applications – strong advantage. 
 Familiarity with Linux OS – advantage. 
 Experience with multidisciplinary product development (software + hardware integration) – advantage. 
 What Do I Need Before I Apply
 Availability to travel locally and internationally for various project assignments. 
 Role is full on-site. 
 Benefits
 Meal tickets 
 Holiday voucher 
 Private medical insurance 
 Performance bonus 
 Easter and Christmas bonus 
 Employee referral bonus 
 Bookster subscription
